title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #80 November 1985 Comic Book ISSN 0712-7774 - Dave Sim
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #80 November 1985 Comic Book is a vintage collectible featuring the character Cerebus created by artist/writer Dave Sim. Published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in the United States, this comic book is part of the Cerebus series and falls under the genre of comics. With an issue number of 80 and published in the Copper Age (1984-1991), this comic is a valuable addition to any comic book collection, especially for fans of US Comics and Dave Sim's work.
